# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_009_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 9

**9:1** Joseph set down his carpenter's axe and also went to join the assembly. When all the widowers had gathered, they went to the high priest, each man carrying his staff. The high priest collected all the staffs and took them into the temple to pray. After completing his prayer, he came out, returned the staffs one by one, and no sign appeared among them.

**9:2** Joseph received the last staff of all. At that moment a dove flew out from his staff and settled on Joseph's head. The priest said to Joseph: "You have been chosen to take the virgin of the Lord into your care and keeping."

**9:3** But Joseph resisted: "I already have sons, and I am an old man, while she is a young girl. I will become a laughingstock among the children of Israel."

**9:4** The priest answered: "Joseph, fear the Lord your God. Remember what happened to Dathan and Abiram and Korah — how the ground split open and swallowed them alive because they challenged God. Fear lest the same befall your household."

**9:5** And Joseph, now afraid, accepted Mary into his keeping. He said to her: "Mary, I have received you from the temple of the Lord. I am leaving you now in my house while I go to work on my building projects. The Lord will guard over you. I will return to you."
